movie.title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
movie.overview: Raj is a rich, carefree, happy-go-lucky second generation NRI. Simran is the daughter of Chaudhary Baldev Singh, who in spite of being an NRI is very strict about adherence to Indian values. Simran has left for India to be married to her childhood fiancé. Raj leaves for India with a mission at his hands, to claim his lady love under the noses of her whole family. Thus begins a saga.

facts: Here's a fun detail: Raj isn't just an NRI, he's specifically a *second-generation* one! This might explain his carefree, happy-go-lucky vibe.
Talk about an interesting character! Simran's father, Chaudhary Baldev Singh, is an NRI himself, yet he's incredibly strict about traditional Indian values.
Did you catch this? Simran is actually heading to India to marry her *childhood fiancé*. Raj certainly has his work cut out for him!
